title: Explore a minimal systems language with C-level front-end speed
description: Research C, C++, D, Rust, Zig, public Jai, and academic work with subagents. Write a source-checked exploration and bounded language proposal. Make C-level front-end speed the primary gate. Include fast readable syntax, parallel compiler stages, and safe user-implemented intrusive doubly-linked lists. Define compilation/runtime gates and production witnesses. Documentation only; no compiler implementation.
close_reason: Completed the source-linked language and academic exploration, concrete ownership and checked intrusive-list design, syntax and parallel stage proposal, and measurable acceptance gates.

title: Measure frontend compilation costs in C, C++, and Rust
description: Profile installed compilers on pinned real source workloads. Exclude backend optimization and code emission. Record repeatable commands, process timing, disjoint phase attribution, source hashes, tool versions, and measurement limits. Add results to the language study.
close_reason: Measured 160 frontend checks, 24 phase profiles, and 4 sampling profiles for pinned C/C++/Rust workloads. Saved reproducible scripts, evidence, profiler-overhead analysis, source-checked boundaries, and design consequences. Validated data coverage, trace accounting, input checks, timeout cleanup, and repeat analysis.
